'''Blue Leader''' or '''Blue One''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the [[Squadron Leader/Legends|leader]] of Blue Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Blue Leader.

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
[[File:Blue_Leader_at_Battle_of_Ryloth.png|thumb|left|210px|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] flying as Blue Leader during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]]]
As "Blue Squadron Leader", [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] commanded a [[Blue Squadron (Jedi Order)|Blue Squadron]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], leading the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 Jedi starfighters]] in [[First Battle of Kamino|defense]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="R50" />

Later in the war, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flew as Blue Leader in the [[Battle of Rendili]], informing [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|squadron]] subordinate "[[Blue Five/Legends|Blue Five]]" that "[[Red Four/Legends|Red Four]]," another pilot, had been dispatched for support in combat against a swarm of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]]. "Blue Five" returned the favor later in the battle, destroying a vulture droid in front of "Blue Leader".<ref name="R70">[[Republic 70|''Republic'' 70]]</ref>

[[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone trooper pilot]] [[Axe (clone trooper)/Legends|Axe]] commanded a Blue Squadron of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under the title of "Blue Leader"<ref name="S1 Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> prior to [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] taking over the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]], leading the squadron's V-19 Torrent starfighters into [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|battle]] over [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in her [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Delta-7B Jedi starfighter]].<ref name="SOR" /> Tano returned to the call sign while leading a group of [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|clone SCUBA troopers]] at the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]].<ref name="WW">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>

Later [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] used the call sign during the [[battle of Ukio]].

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Xiaan Amersu]] flew as Blue leader in the final battle of the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]], sacrificing herself by colliding with and destroying a Separatist planetary gun.<ref name="Rep77">[[Republic 77|''Republic'' 77]]</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
In his final exam for starfighter flight training in his second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] attending [[Jedi academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Roan Novachez]] was assigned as Blue Leader, with [[Cyrus (Jedi Academy)|Cyrus]] and [[Cronah]] as his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]] [[Blue Two/Legends|Blue Two]] and [[Blue Three/Legends|Blue Three]].
{{Noncanonend}}

===Rebel Alliance===
A [[Rebel pilot/Legends|rebel pilot]] flying as Blue Leader led his [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|squadron]] on a scouting mission in [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatooine's orbit]], where he was surprised by the absence of the heavy [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity reported in the area. Sweeping the sector, "Blue Leader" cleared [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] to enter the system, unknowingly springing an [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|trap]].<ref name="EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Merrick Simms]] was designated as Blue Leader during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="RA" /> and again for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="AGttSWU3">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' {{C|"Blue Leader"}}</ref> where he was killed in an attack on the Imperial [[Pride of Tarlandia|main communications ship]].<ref name="ROTJnovel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novel]]</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] served as Blue Leader during patrol duties over [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], leading Blue Flight in [[Rescue of Domina Tagge|rescuing]] [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge's]] freighter from attacking [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]].<ref name="SW35">[[Star Wars (1977) 35|''Star Wars'' (1977) 35]]</ref>

[[Olin Garn]] flew an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptor]] as Blue Leader while performing reconnaissance on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy tied to a [[Death Star II/Legends|vast construction project]] based on intelligence provided by Imperial defector Commander [[Zaletta]].<ref name="XWAOSG">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] pilot [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] became Blue Leader following the death of Merrick Simms at the Battle of Endor, before dying at the hand of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]].<ref name="XWRL1">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 1|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 1]]</ref>

===New Republic===
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Edor Crespin]] led the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|Blue Squadron]], stationed on [[Folor Base]]. During the base's [[Battle of Folor|evacuation]], Crespin flew an A-wing interceptor as Blue Leader.<ref name="XWWS" />

A pilot designated Blue Leader commanded Blue Team's starfighters at the [[Battle of Calamari]], directing the team transfer power from their [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] to [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and [[Laser/Legends|lasers]].<ref name="DEaudio">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>

An [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] pilot flying as Blue Leader led Blue Team in the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Onderon]], and was directed by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to provide cover as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] boarded the ''[[Eclipse II]]''.<ref name="EE">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Luke Skywalker's [[Garven Dreis/Legends|squadron leader]] is identified as "Blue Leader" in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]]<ref name="ANHn">''[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]''</ref> and [[Star Wars (1977) 6|comic adaptation]]<ref name="SW6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref> of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], but uses the call sign [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] in the final film.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
